title: Engineering Standards — reyemtech/laravel-hubspot
summary: Binding CI-enforced engineering standards for the laravel-hubspot package, plus seven recorded decisions of which six await sign-off.
notes: Manifest-typed ADR (authoritative). Document status is 'Draft for review', so locked=false per the Accepted-only rule; however sections 1-13 are stated as binding and CI-enforced and should be treated as locked constraints by the synthesizer. 'Decisions needing sign-off' lists SEVEN items numbered 0-6: #2 (Pest) is settled; #0 merge-commits-vs-release-please, #1 PHP floor ^8.2, #3 declare(strict_types=1), #4 coverage 95%/MSI 80%, #5 final by default, #6 function hard limit 150 lines remain UNSIGNED — extract as open decisions, not locked. 'Not standards, deliberately' section records four explicit rejections (commit signing, 100% coverage, Rector in CI, docs site) — non-goals.
